about: Get a visa to complete the 10-year Golden Residence process as a top secondary school graduate already in the UAE.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Golden Residence visa for top high school students (inside the UAE). Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Top state-level rank with at least 95% from a public or private secondary school
Recommendation letter from the Ministry of Education (Emirates Schools Establishment); the page lists it under terms, not documents
Passport valid for at least 6 months
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App
